question: Chakri is a group song. It is a popular form of folk music of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kashmir**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Chakri is one of the most popular types of** traditional music played in Jammu & Kashmir. **
 
• Chakri is a **responsorial song** form with instrumental parts, and it is played with instruments like harmonium, sarangi, nout, and rubab. 
 
• It is performed in folk and religious spheres, by the** Muslim and Hindu Kashmiris.**
 
• Chakri was also used to** tell stories like fairy tales or famous love stories** such as Yousuf-Zulaikha, Laila-Majnun, etc.
 
• It ends with** Rouf**, which is a name given to a dance form in Kashmir but here, the** fast ending notes** of Chakri are also called Rouf.
